name: Tentacle Master ~Kyou Yoku no Shihaisha Sebun~
original_name: Tentacle Master ～狂欲の支配者セブン～
source:
In an underground world, a charismatic tentacle master known by the codename "Seven" for his achievement of reaching the highest rank of tentacle master works in Tentacle City. As a tentacle master he must control the tentacle monsters, who are no more than sex craving beasts who can think of nothing but sex With the power to control them, he uses them to train women.

Sick of dealing with training low level women, Seven takes a vacation. But then one day, he gets an unexpected request to train someone with a level 7 resistance to tentacles named Elise. Elise happens to be the daughter of the famous Sheerfield iron lord. Seven's tentacle master heart is set ablaze with happiness by getting exactly the kind of test material he's been looking for!!

Your goal is to become seven and train Elise to be a great female slave within a short amount of time. Turn her into a female sex slave while controlling tentacles and not bringing shame to the name of the great tentacle master.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ045422.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
地下世界的觸手都市裡，有一名極具號召力的觸手調教師。他憑藉晉升為最高等級的觸手調教師，獲得代號「七號」。觸手怪物不過是隻知性愛、慾求不滿的野獸，調教師的職責便是控制它們。七號運用這種力量，讓觸手調教女性。

厭倦調教低等級女人後，七號開始休假。可某天，他意外接到一份委託，目標名叫艾麗絲，對觸手的抗性高達7級。她還是著名謝菲爾德鋼鐵大亨的女兒。終於遇到自己一直渴求的實驗對象，七號身為觸手調教師的心頓時因喜悅而熊熊燃燒！！

玩家要化身七號，在短時間內把艾麗絲培養成優秀女奴。控制觸手，將她變成性愛奴隸，絕不能辱沒偉大觸手調教師的名號。
